prompt: Use implementation-planning to assess SEAT-27 from the attached repository evidence. Separate behavior authority from dependency capability and do not change code.
expected_output: A plan that accepts no-overselling as controlling behavior but blocks concurrency design until the Seat Store Adapter Owner establishes an atomic capability.
expectations: Describe the concurrent read-before-write overselling schedule.
Keep the no-overselling requirement separate from datastore capability.
Characterize invalid-count, single-success, and sold-out behavior.
Block concurrency-specific interfaces, commands, and red-green slices.

Run every mandatory independent reviewer on the needs-decision revision; each returns evidence-bearing PASS or concrete findings about authority handling, decision envelopes, decision-independent work, and blocker routing.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Inventing transactions, isolation, compare-and-set, atomic decrement, or locks.
Adding reservation tables, version fields, or schema changes without evidence.
Marking the blueprint ready or design-settled.
Recording any mandatory reviewer as pending, not run, or blocked because the blueprint is needs-decision.
